scenario.name: B2BUA gateway inbound limit: refused 486, then admitted once the slot is free
scenario.send:
INVITE sip:refused@[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch] From: <sip:caller@[local_ip]>;tag=[pid]Refused[call_number] To: <sip:refused@[remote_ip]> Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 1 INVITE Contact: <sip:caller@[local_ip]:[local_port];transport=[transport]> Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Type: application/sdp Content-Length: [len]
v=0 o=caller 1 1 IN IP[local_ip_type] [local_ip] s=- c=IN IP[media_ip_type] [media_ip] t=0 0 m=audio [media_port] RTP/AVP 0 a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
ACK sip:refused@[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0 [last_Via:] From: <sip:caller@[local_ip]>;tag=[pid]Refused[call_number] [last_To:] Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 1 ACK Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Length: 0

INVITE sip:admitted@[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch] From: <sip:caller@[local_ip]>;tag=[pid]Admitted[call_number] To: <sip:admitted@[remote_ip]> Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 2 INVITE Contact: <sip:caller@[local_ip]:[local_port];transport=[transport]> Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Type: application/sdp Content-Length: [len]
v=0 o=caller 2 2 IN IP[local_ip_type] [local_ip] s=- c=IN IP[media_ip_type] [media_ip] t=0 0 m=audio [media_port] RTP/AVP 0 a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000

ACK sip:[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch] From: <sip:caller@[local_ip]>;tag=[pid]Admitted[call_number] To:[$admitted_to] Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 2 ACK Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Length: 0

BYE sip:[remote_ip]:[remote_port] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=[branch] From: <sip:caller@[local_ip]>;tag=[pid]Admitted[call_number] To:[$admitted_to] Call-ID: [call_id] CSeq: 3 BYE Max-Forwards: 70 Content-Length: 0
